proposition.claim:
Corollary 1.7 (p. 7) is phrased for an \(\mathbb R^m\) action of upper triangular unipotents in \[G=SL(2,\mathbb R)\times SL(2,k_1)\times\cdots\times SL(2,k_n),
\qquad m\leq 1+n .\] Section 11.4 (p. 86; released `main.tex`, lines 4997–4998) obtains a splitting directly from Theorem 9.2. However, the latter uses the generating set \(E\) fixed in Section 3.1(11), p. 22: in the product case it contains \(u=E_{12}\) in the first factor and a nonzero nilpotent \(v\) from another factor. Section 9.2 (p. 64) expressly retains this choice. The definition of a friendly pair also excludes zero vectors (p. 22).
